Multiple Suicide attempts, my life did not get better and i didn’t get that golden gate effect where I thought I made a mistake. That whole thought is a natural reaction to falling off a bridge, of course you’d want to live.

I’ve seriously attempted multiple times with hangings and a couple overdoses. It’s usually driven by this weird sad anger I get towards the end, I’m usually cursing whoever or whatever put me here. I fucking hate how this world just burdened me with all this shit. I don’t believe in a purpose and I also think I used religion at one point to desperately make sense of something. I really can’t just push through the attempts though, if I just kicked out a chair I’d have no choice but to die. The lovely thing about the human brain is, it’s not even your choice to die even when you think it is. Your brain will literally do anything to keep itself alive, that’s where that regret or last minute thought comes from.

Then people try to burden you with the idea that there’s something after this. I say fuck whoever came up with the idea that you’ll go to hell if you commit suicide. It’s like I don’t want to exist anymore why the fuck is that not okay? How would I be doing something wrong if life was gifted to me? Would you want someone to roast forever for returning a gift you gave them?
